This page records how the native engine's optimizer is tested and where its
technical decisions are written down. The two tables below are generated from
the repository files at site build (`tests/sim/gates.csv`,
`tests/sim/structures.csv` and the front matter of `planning/specs/ADR-*.md`),
so they cannot drift from them. Plan and ledger:
`planning/specs/BRAINSTORM-optimizer-quality-control-2026-10-23.md`.
The model syntax for the external oracles (lavaan, OpenMx, and the candidate semopy) is on
[One model in medfit, lavaan, OpenMx and semopy](syntax-crosswalk.html).

```{r}
#| label: qc-sources
root <- normalizePath(file.path("..", ".."), mustWork = FALSE)
sim <- file.path(root, "tests", "sim")
have <- file.exists(file.path(sim, "qc-lib.R")) && file.exists(file.path(sim, "gates.csv")) &&
  file.exists(file.path(sim, "structures.csv"))
if (have) source(file.path(sim, "qc-lib.R"))
```

## Principles

- Every number has an independent oracle (lavaan, OpenMx, OLS, a hand
  calculation or a known truth).
- Every gate has a planted defect it must catch, and the driver plants
  defects in every gate's results.
- An unresolved result beats a wrong one: a refit or a branch that cannot be
  fitted is reported as unresolved or stops the fit; it is never replaced by
  the best of the others.
- Evidence is designed before it is run: the gate's thresholds and design are
  committed first.

## Gate catalog

```{r}
#| label: qc-gates
if (have) {
  knitr::kable(qc_gate_table(utils::read.csv(file.path(sim, "gates.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
                             utils::read.csv(file.path(sim, "structures.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
} else {
  cat("The gate catalog is generated from the repository and is not available in this build.\n")
}
```

A token in *Planted defects* is a `MUTANT=` value of the gate's script; the
driver (`tests/sim/run-gates.R --mutants`) also plants tolerance, missing,
failed, unreadable and stale results in every gate. `test-gate-coverage.R`
fails when a row has no oracle, names a defect its script does not contain,
or when a structure has no gate.

## Decision log

```{r}
#| label: qc-decisions
adrs <- if (have) list.files(file.path(root, "planning", "specs"), pattern = "^ADR-.*[.]md$", full.names = TRUE)
if (have && length(adrs) && requireNamespace("yaml", quietly = TRUE)) {
  knitr::kable(qc_decision_table(adrs))
} else {
  cat("The decision log is generated from the ADR front matter and is not available in this build.\n")
}
```

Each ADR opens with a YAML `decisions:` list (`id`, `title`, `status`, `date`,
optional `supersedes`); `test-adr-front-matter.R` checks it. The ADR is the
source; this table only reads it.

## Adding a model

A change that alters the objective, the parameter vector, the constraint set,
the bounds or the solver path (the files in `tests/sim/risk-files.txt`) is
high-risk, and its pull request body carries this checklist, each item ticked
or `n/a: <reason>` (the `risk-tier` workflow checks it). Every new model class
needs at least items 1 to 3.

| # | Check | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Independent oracle | lavaan, OpenMx, OLS or a hand calculation agrees within a stated tolerance |
| 2 | Reliability cell | the structure is in the reliability grid (default and random starts, the data scales) |
| 3 | Planted defect | a mutant the gate must reject |
| 4 | Metamorphic invariance | rescaling a variable, reordering syntax, or a redundant constraint leaves the answer unchanged |
| 5 | Fault injection | bad solver statuses and non-finite values are refused or retried, never accepted |
| 6 | Registration | a `gates.csv` row with `oracle` and `mutants`, and a row in `structures.csv` |
| 7 | Platform run | the gate passes on the OpenBLAS runner |

## The monthly run

The `qc-monthly` workflow runs the gates on `dev` on the first of each month, appends one row
to a history on the `qc-results` branch (the environment fingerprint, one
PASS or FAIL per gate, the largest restoration ratio, the reliability match
rate, the oracle-sweep outcomes), and opens one deduplicated GitHub issue when
a gate fails or the R version, BLAS library, nloptr, lavaan or OpenMx version
changes. The runner image is recorded and never alerts. Drift bands are not set
yet: they need about eight rows (eight months at this cadence; a manual run adds one sooner), and a
change merged to `dev` can go unseen for up to a month unless a run is started by hand or a pull request
carries the `run-qc` label. The workflow has not run on GitHub at
the time of writing, so the history does not exist yet.

## Known limits

- No latent-model solver benchmark exists; the solver decisions that depend on
  one are marked proposed in the decision log.
- Gates run on the runner's OpenBLAS; the reference BLAS needs a separate
  container.
- Other seeds and scales of the nonlinear floor fixture are not covered.
